about: Shared school data for the three sports games (football, basketball, baseball). Built from research/schools-and-athletics.md; see that file for every source. Real school names, cities, classifications and title years are setting only. NO real players, students or coaches: generate fictional players. NO logos: mascotConcept describes original geometric art to draw in code. Hex colors are stand-ins, not official values. Where colorsConfirmed is false, even the color NAMES are game choices (label them 'game colors' in credits). Venue names with venueConfirmed false are invented or unverified: use the generic venue text instead of presenting them as real.

rivalries.label: Garland County rivalry
facts: The schools are about 15 miles apart.
Played every year from 1968 except two years in the 1970s.
Paused after 1999 over rowdy behavior by students from both schools; the series was renewed in 2018 (announced June 2017) after a 19-year break.
2023: Lakeside 49, Lake Hamilton 42 at Wolf Stadium, Pearcy.
rivalries.note: No trophy or official game name exists; any name is invented and should read as invented.

rulesContext: Arkansas senior high basketball adopted a 35-second shot clock, effective 2022-23 (AAA vote 183-69, August 2020).
Football classifications and conferences are set in two-year cycles (2024-26, 2026-28).
Unconfirmed NFHS defaults: 11-player football with 12-minute quarters, 8-minute basketball quarters, 7-inning baseball. Present these as game rules, not as cited facts.
